  by_cases hn : n = 0

      | succ n'' =>
        -- n ≥ 2

        · subst hn2

          <;> norm_num
          <;> linarith
        · -- n ≥ 3
          have h_ge_3 : n ≥ 3 := by
            omega

          have h_pow_ineq : (n : ℕ)^3 ≤ 3^n := by
            have h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≥ 3 → k^3 ≤ 3^k := by
